settings.heading: How do I place an order?
settings.row_content: Simply choose your meals on our website, add them to your cart, and check out securely.

settings.heading: Do you change your menu?
settings.row_content: Yes, our menu updates regularly to feature new, chef-crafted dishes that blend fresh ingredients, creativity, and elegant presentation.

settings.heading: What kind of meals do you offer?
settings.row_content: We serve chef-prepared, customizable dishes made with premium ingredients and crafted for both taste and style. Each menu is designed to reflect your unique preferences.

settings.heading: How are the meals packaged?
settings.row_content: Each meal comes in a 10–14 oz portion, sealed for freshness and convenience.

settings.heading: Are your meals fresh or frozen?
settings.row_content: All meals are delivered fresh and ready to heat, never frozen.

settings.heading: How do I heat the meals?
settings.row_content: Meals are fully cooked, simply microwave for 2–3 minutes or heat in the oven until warm.

settings.heading: How long do the meals last?
settings.row_content: Meals stay fresh in the refrigerator for up to 5 days. You can also freeze them for longer shelf life.

settings.heading: When will my meals be delivered?
settings.row_content: We deliver every Monday and Tuesday between 8:30 AM – 7:30 PM.

settings.heading: Do you deliver to my area?
settings.row_content: We currently deliver throughout Roswell and surrounding areas within our delivery network.
